mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO salary_summary ( employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, period_id, settlement_month, period_start_date, period_end_date, currency, exchange_rate, salary_subtotal, salary_deduction_total, salary_total, payment_status, create_time, update_time, delete_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.employeeId}, #{item.employeeCode}, #{item.employeeName}, #{item.periodId}, #{item.settlementMonth}, #{item.periodStartDate}, #{item.periodEndDate}, #{item.currency}, #{item.exchangeRate}, #{item.salarySubtotal}, #{item.salaryDeductionTotal}, #{item.salaryTotal}, #{item.paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = VALUES(update_time), salary_subtotal = VALUES(salary_subtotal), salary_deduction_total = VALUES(salary_deduction_total), salary_total = VALUES(salary_total), payment_status = IF(payment_status = 1, 1, VALUES(payment_status))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM salary_summary WHERE id IN #{id}
